mapper.select: SELECT signing_key_id AS signingKeyId, realm, kid, algorithm, public_jwk_schema_version AS publicJwkSchemaVersion, public_jwk_canonical_json AS publicJwkCanonicalJson, status, active_slot AS activeSlot, not_before AS notBefore, signing_end_time AS signingEndTime, verification_end_time AS verificationEndTime FROM t_jwt_signing_key WHERE realm = 'OPERATIONS' AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'RETIRING') ORDER BY CASE status WHEN 'ACTIVE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, kid
